rejection_summary.title: The Runner
rejection_summary.reason: Gal Gadot's 84-minute phone-directed running thriller is fast-moving, but independent whole-film reviews describe repetitive running and talking, weak tension and unexciting physical action. Speed alone is not sufficient evidence of action density.

rejection_summary.title: Gumraah
rejection_summary.reason: A dual-suspect murder investigation drives its 127-minute structure; evidence supports isolated praised action scenes but not sustained action across the full film.
